notes.text: Available in cPanel 108 and later; operates on the selected cPanel account. Omitted optional arguments, including null, remain omitted; explicit empty strings, false and zero are sent according to their parameter types. No client-side defaults are substituted.

Returns the pinned FeatureDescriptions object with optional features string list, id string and title string. The formal source is an object, not a list of role objects; no example-driven widening is inferred.
